description: Create an envelope with a PDF document, add a signer, and send it for e-signature. Returns the envelope ID and a signing URL. Provide either a local file path (pdf_path) or base64-encoded PDF content (pdf_base64).

pdf_path.description: Local file path to the PDF document (alternative to pdf_base64)

signer_email.description: Email address of the person who needs to sign

name: create_and_send
